title: Add automatic retry for transient errors
body: We should support automatic retries with an exponential backoff strategy for transient network failures in the requests library session layer, so callers do not need to wrap every request manually.

title: Improve timeout handling documentation
body: The documentation for connect and read timeouts is unclear. We should add examples showing how to set total and per-read timeouts when using the requests library with a session.

title: Support HTTP/2 via an optional adapter
body: Add an optional HTTP/2 adapter so that users can benefit from multiplexing when the server supports it, and discuss how it interacts with the existing urllib3 based transport layer.
